## 8. Evidence status and limits {#unconfirmed}

Read instruction inventory, LLVM target support, mechanism descriptions and validation as separate evidence dimensions. The [shared status definitions](#evidence-conventions) apply throughout this reference; the table below focuses on feature reports and unresolved mechanisms.

### Feature reports and unresolved mechanisms {#feature-evidence-limits}

:::: {.reading-block}

Three entries have unconfirmed support: RDNA 4 LPDDR5 awareness and RDNA 3 / RDNA 4 single-use VGPR write suppression.

AMD confirms the three RDNA 3.5 features listed here; their remaining gaps concern implementation details.

The Radeon 700M memory improvement is confirmed for that product, while its equivalence to RDNA 3.5 LPDDR5 awareness is unconfirmed. Compression equivalence across generations is also unresolved.

::::

:::: {.note}

An unspecified implementation is not an unconfirmed feature. These labels describe the reviewed sources; see the [status definitions](#evidence-conventions).

### Validation status {#validation-status}

**Source inspected:** the ISA references and XML inventory identified in [Appendix A](#evidence-appendix), plus the pinned compiler code and regression expectations in the [LLVM companion evidence section](../rdna-llvm-dependencies/index.qmd#compiler-evidence). **Not executed:** those LLVM regression tests and GPU benchmarks. The linked evidence records the exact source-check coverage; source inspection does not establish GPU behavior or performance.
